card.name: Small words in hypersensitivity warnings
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of", "its" and "the" in allergy and contraindication phrasing, especially "any of its components" and "swelling of the face". Also fires on a few section-opening words or question marks in drug labels.

modes.label: Any of its components
modes.description: The word "its" or "other" after "hypersensitivity to X or any of" in contraindications.
modes.example: AINDICATIONS Tretinoin capsules are contraindicated in patients with a known hypersensitivity to tretinoin capsules, any of<< its>> components, or other retinoids.

modes.label: Swelling or edema of
modes.description: The word "of" or "the" after swelling or edema, leading into the face, mouth or throat.
modes.example: If you experience any of the more serious Ritalin side effects or if you have an allergic reaction to Ritalin LA, such as swelling of<< the>> face, mouth or throat, seek immediate

modes.label: Section or question openers
modes.description: A question mark or the first word after a warning heading in a label.
modes.example: 5.3 Hepatotoxicity<< In>> clinical trials of oral diclofenac
